title: Guides

The <link rel="canonical"> should be https://example.com/my-site/guides.html.

title: Home
text:
This example demonstrates the site-level metadata features:

Title prefix. Each page’s <title> becomes <page title> – <website.title>. This page’s <title> should read Home – My Site.
site-url. When website.site-url is set, Quarto emits a _site/sitemap.xml listing every rendered page with absolute URLs derived from the site URL, plus a _site/robots.txt pointing search engines at the sitemap.
Favicon. website.favicon: favicon.svg causes Quarto to copy the favicon to _site/favicon.svg and add <link rel="icon"> to every page’s <head>.
Canonical URL. Each page’s <head> contains <link rel="canonical"> pointing at its absolute URL — useful when content might be reachable through several paths.

See Guides and API.
